jobs.title: AI Response Evaluator

jobs.description: iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing. Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match. What you will do Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins Verify factual claims using approved research sources Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing What you bring: Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases Solid research skills and attention to detail Excellent reading comprehension Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision Good to know Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. Fully remote and flexible. You choose your hours as long as volume and deadlines are met. Task volume varies with project demand.

This is a role for a designer who finds the hard problems more interesting than the shiny ones: simplifying deeply established hospitality workflows without breaking what operators depend on, exploring what agentic experiences can make possible, and finding the right balance between automation, human judgment, and control. Make complicated operations feel simple: distill dense, high-frequency workflows across the front and back of house into clear, fast, confidence-inspiring experiences. Design for trust and control: make AI behavior understandable, provide meaningful ways to review and intervene, and ensure people remain confidently in charge of important decisions. Ground decisions in evidence: drive your own research and testing with real hospitality operators and staff, so improvements are built on how people actually work, not assumptions. Design with real-world constraints as creative fuel — partnering closely with engineering and product to find solutions that are both excellent and feasible in mature, at-scale systems. Put AI to work in your craft — using modern tools to explore, prototype, and validate faster, and modeling new ways of working for the team. What you need to bring: 8+ years of product design experience at product-driven tech companies, with measurable impact on shipped products. Active use of AI tools in your design workflow, and curiosity about how agentic systems are changing the craft and the products we build. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform
jobs.description: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the AI Platform Team at Smartly! Our team works on helping marketers make the most of their ad creatives (images, video, text) and campaigns (product and performance data). We build and experiment with AI-based solutions across the media and creative workflows.You will have the opportunity to take ownership of and work on high impact projects. Join us in building high impact ML-based solutions to help our customers to build better and more effective advertising experiences for their consumers. If you're a growth minded individual who has a passion for ML and the marketing space, this team is for you! We use Python, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Node.js, Docker and Kubernetes for our microservices, TypeScript and React in the frontend of our products. Here's What You'll Do... Design, build and maintain backend services that sit at the core of Smartly.io's campaign optimization products. Be a core contributor of our team and our ways of working to build high impact products. You'll actively be involved in work planning, retrospectives, and overall team improvement. Support data scientists in bringing machine learning models to production. Mentor your team on software development practices and propagate best practices like testing, monitoring, or clean code. Use your skills and experience to continuously improve our software architecture, coding practices, tools, and processes. Work with our stakeholders - be them product, engineering, infrastructure - to ensure we meet customers where they are. Being able to translate business/product needs to viable solutions is a must. Apply and enhance your soft skills through working closely with your colleagues and our customers. Doing knowledge shares, running productive meetings, and pair programming/debugging are just some ways we grow our soft skills. Impact the daily life of the staff of the hundreds of advertisers using Smartly Here's What We're Looking For... Inclusive Culture: Join a team of over 750 Smartlies representing more than 60 nationalities across 24 locations in 13 countries, we foster a culture built on trust, transparency, and open feedback. jobs.title: Expert Tech Solution Architect - HR (m/f/d)
jobs.description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.   As Senior / Expert HR Tech Solution Architect , you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix's global HR technology landscape. Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix's future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally. You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within. This role is based in Munich, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.   About the Role Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements. Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations — evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization. Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems — determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures. Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations. Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live. About You 8+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field. Strong HR domain and Workday expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape. Any Workday certifications would be an advantage. Demonstrable experience driving Workday transformations, including major Workday redesigns, platform revamps and/or migrations end to end. Hands-on enterprise Workday experience across configuration, integration or migration is a strong differentiator. Strong integration and systems architecture knowledge, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, data flows and event-driven architectures across complex enterprise environments. Experience supporting the design of HR target operating models, HR service-delivery models and technology governance frameworks, including security and role models, segregation of duties, audit trails, internal controls and data privacy in regulated, multi-country environments. jobs.description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.   As ( Senior) HR Tech & AI Automation Analyst, you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team as a bridge between HR and technology — deeply understanding how HR works end to end and translating business challenges into scalable technology, automation and AI solutions. You will work across the hire-to-retire employee lifecycle, partnering with HR teams to challenge existing processes, identify opportunities for improvement and turn business needs into clear functional and technical requirements. You will then help take those solutions from idea through design, build and implementation — using our HR technology landscape, automation platforms and AI. You will bring deep HR domain knowledge and hands-on technical capability to translate complex HR processes into scalable, technology-enabled solutions — from automation workflows and AI-powered tools to HRIS improvements and service delivery design. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation, who is part of the HR Senior Leadership Team, and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams across all regions. This role is based in Munich. Given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.   About the Role Act as a trusted technology partner to HR teams across the end-to-end employee lifecycle — conduct process and technology gap analyses, challenge existing ways of working, identify improvement and automation opportunities, and translate business needs into functional and technical requirements implemented through HRIS, AI or automation solutions. Drive HR Tech initiatives end to end, from requirements engineering and process/solution design through build, SIT/UAT, implementation and go-live across areas such as HR service delivery model, HRIS security model improvements, payroll transformations, HRIS revamp or migration. Bring a strong product mindset to HR technology — turning business problems into scalable products and frameworks, including Jira-based HR service desks, Rovo Agents and AI-enabled employee/HR experiences, and continuously improving them based on user needs and business value. jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description: FlixTrain ist die Challenger-Marke im deutschen Fernverkehr: grün, mutig und anders als der Platzhirsch. Auf Social Media wollen wir genau das zeigen, nicht als Kanäle, die „auch noch mitlaufen", sondern als eigenständige Bühne, auf der unsere Marke für digital-first Zielgruppen erlebbar wird.   Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d) , der Organic Social bei FlixTrain weiterdenkt. Einige Kanäle laufen schon, aber ohne eigene Handschrift. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel: Du machst aus mitlaufenden Kanälen eine eigenständige FlixTrain-Präsenz. Du bekommst einen Startpunkt mit Reichweite, aber freie Hand beim Aufbau von Strategie, Struktur, Prozessen und Partner-Setup. Du entscheidest, wo wir spielen und wo nicht, übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformgerecht und machst Wirkung messbar. Die Rolle ist Teil des Brand Teams und bewusst als eigenverantwortliche Aufbaurolle angelegt: Du bist In-House-Kopf und Taktgeber, die Produktion steuerst du über Agentur, Creator und internes Creative Team.   Entscheidend ist eine Haltung: Nähe zum Zeitgeist, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen. Wir wollen Reichweite mit Substanz: Content, der zur Marke passt, nicht bloße Content-Masse.   Über die Rolle   Strategie & Where-to-play   Du entwickelst die  Organic - Social -Strategie für  FlixTrain : klare Ziele, Zielgruppen und Kommunikations-Säulen: abgeleitet aus der übergeordneten Markenstrategie, nicht als Insel.   Du triffst die  Where -to-play-Entscheidung: Du prüfst die bestehenden Kanäle, entscheidest, welche wir fokussieren und welche bewusst nicht, und identifizierst, wo  FlixTrain  zusätzlich präsent sein sollte.   Du definierst das Zusammenspiel aus „Big Moment"-Ideen (große, reichweitenstarke Momente, die kulturelle Relevanz schaffen) und  Ongoing -Community-Content (kontinuierlich, näher an der bestehenden Community)    Markenübersetzung & Content   Du übersetzt die  FlixTrain -Marke plattformnativ – nicht als adaptierten Kampagnen- Cutdown , sondern als eigenständige, kanaltypische Formate, die organisch wirken statt „gebrandet".   Du sorgst dafür, dass Content zum Zeitgeist UND zur Marke passt: Du kombinierst Entertainment- und Kultur-Trends mit echtem Markenfit – kein Trend-Hopping, kein „AI-Slop", kein Content um des Contents willen.   Du betreibst Community Management, hältst die Marke im Dialog präsent und behältst auch bei kritischen Themen einen souveränen Ton – mit dem Gespür, wann ein Fall an PR gehört.   Partner- & Produktions-Setup   Du baust das richtige Partner-Setup auf und steuerst es .  Darüber hinaus managst du das Budget eigenverantwortlich und entscheidest, welche Inhalte gezielt verstärkt werden.   Measurement & Wirkung   Du machst die Wirkung von  Organic   Social  mit den richtigen KPIs je Zielstellung und Maßnahme messbar — von Big-Moment Content bis hin zu  Ongoing -Content — und etablierst ein durchdachtes Reporting, aus dem du gezielt  Learnings  für die nächste Planungsrunde ableitest.   Stakeholder & Schnittstellen   Du arbeitest eng mit dem Brand Team, dem FlixBus  Social  Media Team und dem Creative Team zusammen und sorgst für strategische Konsistenz zwischen  Organic , Paid und Kampagne.   Du bist Sparringspartner für interne Stakeholder und externe Partner und vertrittst  Social  souverän gegenüber Management und Fachbereichen.   Über Dich   Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Organic-Social - bzw. Content-Marketing – idealerweise mit Erfahrung auf Unternehmens- und Agenturseite.   Du bist Generalist: Du denkst strategisch ( Where -to-play, KPIs, Positionierung) und bleibst gleichzeitig  hands -on in Redaktionsplanung, Briefing und Steuerung.   Du hast  Social -Strukturen oder -Kanäle aufgebaut oder maßgeblich

jobs.title: AI Security Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Clariness is looking for an AI Security Engineer (f/m/d) based Germany, UK, SA, or Serbia. - Full-time; unlimited - About the role: This role is about building, operating and continuously improving Clariness' security capabilities across applications, cloud infrastructure and AI systems. As our founding-level security hire, you will establish the security engineering function, define its priorities and work directly with engineering teams to embed effective security controls throughout our technology environment. As an AI Security Engineer, you would be responsible for: Defining Clariness' security engineering strategy and roadmap, and building and operating the security function across application security, cloud security, AI and LLM security, vulnerability management and supporting security tooling. Working directly with engineering teams on secure system design, threat modelling, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation, while embedding appropriate security controls into development processes and CI/CD pipelines. Owning AI security and governance across LLM-powered features, RAG systems and agentic pipelines, including assessing and mitigating risks covered by the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications. Designing and validating safeguards for AI agents, including sandboxing, privilege and access controls, secure tool use and adversarial red teaming of AI systems. Evaluating, deploying and continuously improving AI-powered security automation, including autonomous vulnerability triage, LLM-powered alert analysis, compliance evidence gathering and AI-assisted threat intelligence. Assessing commercial and open-source security tools based on effectiveness, operational fit and cost, and developing custom solutions where existing tooling does not meet Clariness' requirements. Managing Clariness' IT security compliance programme—including SOC 2 Type II, applicable EU AI Act high-risk obligations, GDPR Article 32 technical measures and GxP IT security controls—while maintaining audit-ready documentation and acting as the primary security liaison for external auditors, regulators, Legal and Compliance. We would like you to have:  At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or information security, with strong technical depth beyond advisory or governance responsibilities. Proven experience building or significantly developing a security programme within a product engineering environment, ideally as an early or founding security hire. Strong practical experience across application security, cloud security, secure software development, threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security controls within CI/CD pipelines. Experience assessing, testing or implementing security controls for LLM-powered applications, RAG systems or agentic pipelines. Hands-on experience with AI agents, either building them for security automation or securing them through adversarial testing, sandboxing and privilege controls. Demonstrable compliance experience involving at least one SOC 2 audit cycle, GDPR programme ownership or implementation of EU AI Act requirements, including the ability to produce audit-ready documentation and work with external auditors. Experience in a regulated industry such as clinical research, pharmaceuticals, healthtech or fintech, with knowledge of GxP or comparable regulated data-handling requirements considered a strong advantage, alongside strong English communication skills at C1 level. Über 2.000 Anwält*innen vertrauen JUPUS täglich ihre Mandate an. In drei Jahren sind wir zu einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Legal Tech Unternehmen in Europa geworden – mit 90+ Mitarbeitenden in Köln und Berlin und einem international verteilten Tech-Team. Der Markt ist da. Das Produkt wirkt. Und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jetzt geht es darum, dieses Momentum in echte Marktbewegung zu übersetzen – und genau hier kommt diese Rolle ins Spiel. Outbound ist bei JUPUS kein Nebenkanal. Es ist einer der zentralen Wachstumstreiber – und du wirst ihn anführen. Als Team Lead SDR hast du direkten Einfluss darauf, wie schnell JUPUS in den nächsten zwölf Monaten wächst. Was dich erwartet Du führst ein Team von 12–15 SDRs im operativen Alltag: coachen, Calls mithören, Feedback geben, Energie hochhalten. Dabei geht es nicht nur darum, dass dein Team heute gute Meetings generiert. Deine Aufgabe ist es, aus starken SDRs die nächsten starken Account Executives bei JUPUS zu entwickeln. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit dem AE-Team zusammen, entwickelst deine SDRs gezielt in Richtung Discovery, Einwandbehandlung und Closing weiter und sorgst dafür, dass sie Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung im Sales Cycle übernehmen können. jobs.title: Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.
jobs.description: Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt. Wir sind autoteam augsburg , eine inhabergeführte Kfz-Meisterwerkstatt in Augsburg-Kriegshaber. Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Fahrzeuge irgendwie durch die Werkstatt zu bekommen. Uns ist wichtig, dass sauber gearbeitet wird, Probleme wirklich gelöst werden und unsere Kunden ihr Fahrzeug mit einem guten Gefühl wieder abholen. Wir arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken und decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Inspektionen nach Herstellervorgaben, Diagnose, Bremsen, Motor, Fahrwerk, Klima, Getriebe, Umbauten und vieles mehr. Gerade deshalb ist der Alltag bei uns abwechslungsreich. Kein Tag ist genau wie der andere und wenn ein Fehler nicht sofort auf der Hand liegt, nehmen wir uns die Zeit, ihn wirklich zu finden. Unsere Werkstatt ist modern und sehr gut ausgestattet. Mehrere Hebebühnen, aktuelle Diagnosetechnik und alles, was man braucht, um ordentlich arbeiten zu können. Gleichzeitig legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass die Werkstatt sauber, gepflegt und ein angenehmer Arbeitsplatz ist. Schließlich verbringt man hier einen großen Teil seines Tages und soll sich auch wohlfühlen. Für unser Team suchen wir einen Kfz-Meister (m/w/d) , der sein Handwerk versteht, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust auf ein Umfeld hat, in dem gute Arbeit geschätzt wird. Was wir dir bieten Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung wirklich einbringen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Entscheidungen mitzutreffen und bei anspruchsvolleren Fällen deine Erfahrung einzusetzen. Du unterstützt unser Team bei Diagnose und Fehlersuche, behältst die Qualität der Arbeiten im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass die Abläufe in der Werkstatt stimmen. Wenn du gerne selbst mit am Fahrzeug arbeitest, Fehler suchst und technische Lösungen findest, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen . Das bedeutet bei uns: kurze Wege, direkte Gespräche und schnelle Entscheidungen. Keine Konzernstrukturen, keine unnötigen Umwege und kein Gefühl, nur irgendeine Personalnummer zu sein. Was wir dir außerdem bieten: einen sicheren und langfristigen Arbeitsplatz eine moderne, saubere und sehr gut ausgestattete Werkstatt abwechslungsreiche Arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen kurze Entscheidungswege ein angenehmes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld eine faire und leistungsgerechte Vergütung Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem gute Arbeit gesehen und geschätzt wird Uns ist wichtig, dass man gerne zur Arbeit kommt, vernünftig miteinander umgeht, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und sich aufeinander verlassen kann. Denn am Ende verbringen wir einen großen Teil unseres Tages miteinander und da sollte nicht nur die Arbeit passen, sondern auch das Miteinander. Was du mitbringst Voraussetzung für die Stelle ist ein abgeschlossener Kfz-Meistertitel . Du kennst den Werkstattalltag, kannst selbstständig arbeiten und übernimmst Verantwortung, wenn es darauf ankommt. Bei schwierigeren Diagnosen oder Fehlerbildern gibst du nicht sofort auf, sondern möchtest verstehen, wo das Problem liegt und wie man es vernünftig löst. Außerdem wünschen wir uns jemanden, der: sauber und zuverlässig arbeitet einen hohen Anspruch an die eigene Arbeit hat freundlich und respektvoll mit Kunden und Kollegen umgeht sein Fachwissen gerne ins Team einbringt Entscheidungen treffen kann Verantwortung übernimmt und vor allem noch Freude am Kfz-Handwerk hat Natürlich muss am Ende auch das Menschliche stimmen. Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf. Wir suchen einen guten Meister, der zu uns und zu unserem Team passt . Wenn du momentan in einer Werkstatt arbeitest und dir schon länger denkst, dass eine Veränderung vielleicht genau das Richtige wäre, dann melde dich einfach bei uns. Du musst dafür keinen komplizierten Bewerbungsprozess durchlaufen. Komm vorbei, schau dir unsere Werkstatt an und lern uns kennen. D

jobs.title: GTM DACH
jobs.description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn those smaller scale use cases into enterprise deals. You're the first line to Heidi in DACH. Inbound demand connects you with practices, MVZs and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out or close it yourself. jobs.description: Life at Plume At Plume, we believe that technology isn't about moving faster, it's about making life's moments better. Which is why we've built the world's first, and only, open and hardware-independent service delivery platform for smart homes, small businesses, enterprises, and beyond. Our SaaS platform uses WiFi, advanced AI, and machine learning to create the future of connected spaces—and human experiences—at massive scale. We now deliver services to over 60 million locations globally and have managed over 3 billion devices on our platform. We're expanding rapidly, pioneering a new category, and we achieved our Series F funding in just four years. Our customers include many of the world's largest Internet Service Providers (ISPs) who look to Plume to help them evolve their smart home offerings while gleaning insights from their own data.  With a bias for action and a love for being trailblazers, the team at Plume embodies a combination of relentless curiosity and imaginative innovation. We challenge ourselves to think in ways that other companies don't, work to do what should be done (rather than what can), and if we can't do it exceptionally well, we don't do it. It's how we've assembled a team of world-class builders, thinkers, and doers. And it's how we're reinventing what's possible every day. Our platform sits between their network and the people using it, managing WiFi performance, security, device visibility, care and the digital services layered on top. We are used at scale by some of the largest ISPs across North America, Europe, Asia and the Middle East. The UK and Ireland are mature and concentrated markets. The number of ISPs that matter is small, they are well known to us, and most already have an established approach to managing the connected home. Success here depends on building credibility at a senior level, shaping how these organisations think about the experience they deliver to their subscribers, and then proving that value at scale. We are looking for someone who is at their best in a small number of large, complex accounts rather than in a broad prospecting territory. It is a role with real ownership. The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. jobs.description: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . Why We Need a Platform Security Engineer Now Omnea takes security seriously. In an era where exploits and supply chain attacks are being discovered and conducted faster than ever before, it’s vital that we stay on the cutting edge of keeping our systems and our customers’ data safe. Hardening our systems is only part of the solution. As we scale out to more industries with their diverse security requirements, we want another individual who can help us attain and maintain higher levels of compliance certification. What We're Looking For We're hiring at both Level 3 (Senior) and Level 4 (Staff) . For calibration, candidates typically bring 5+ years of platform engineering experience in high-growth, cloud-native SaaS environments, but we care more about impact than years. We’re looking for that “T”-shaped skillset where the candidate’s depth is in Cloud Security. Furthermore, the ideal candidate will have a product engineering background but caught the bug for security and cares deeply about enabling people to work fast, safely. Finally, we’re looking for someone who sees security as an enabler and force-multiplier and answers questions with a “Yes, here’s how we do it securely” attitude as opposed to the flat “No” security teams are too often renowned for. What You'll Do Implement and take ownership of our Security roadmap. Working with the Platform Lead, a successful candidate will steadily take ownership over the Platform Security Roadmap, leading implementations and experiments to level up Omnea’s security posture. Own Security Tooling. From safe-chain plugins to SAST/DAST tooling, we want someone who’s keen to get stuck in, onboard, and evolve our tooling to ensure our posture stays at the bleeding edge. Deliver Compliance Programs. Omnea plans to tackle multiple additional compliance certifications to enable the business to serve some of the most regulated industries on the planet. You’ll have a massive hand in making sure we’re up to those standards. Collaborate with our DevX streams. Omnea ships fast, and we want to ship even faster. Making sure we can enable that safely and securely will become your wheelhouse. Implement hardening patterns. See an area where code security could be improved? Let’s do it, and do it in a way that can be scaled out across the entire codebase and easily implemented by the rest of the engineering staff. What Can You Expect? A strong team. You'll join a platform team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will push you to do your best work. Modern, cloud-native stack. Everything serverless and IaC-driven (AWS, Pulumi, TypeScript end-to-end). Continuous delivery. We deploy multiple times a day.

jobs.title: Senior MLOps Engineer - Edge
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of <a href="https://www.hudl.com/blog/newsweek-top-100-global-most-loved-workplaces-2023">Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces</a>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<br><br>We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.<br><br>Ready to join us?</p> <div style="padding: 56.25% 0 0 0; position: relative;"><iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0;" src="https://player.vimeo.com/video/1095624224?h=9e8cdc9dbe&amp;badge=0&amp;autopause=0&amp;player_id=0&amp;app_id=58479" width="" height=""></iframe></div> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><h2>Your Role</h2> <p>We're hiring a Senior MLOps Engineer for our Hardware Group to build and scale the machine learning infrastructure that powers Focus, our line of smart cameras. You'll own the edge deployment pipelines that transport neural networks from training clusters to tens of thousands of devices globally, and contribute to the platform that compiles trained models into optimised inference engines for devices like the Jetson Orin, building the "nervous system" for the next generation of automated sports capture.</p> <p>As a Senior MLOps Engineer, you'll:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Build scalable Edge infrastructure.</strong> You'll design, develop, and maintain the delivery systems that enable us to deploy models to fleets of devices.</li> <li><strong>Own the model compilation platform.</strong> You'll build and maintain the pipeline that takes trained models and produces optimised, hardware-specific inference engines — managing TensorRT compilation, precision trade-offs (FP16/INT8), calibration, and engine validation to ensure models run reliably and efficiently on target devices.</li> <li><strong>Work with cross-functional teams.</strong> You'll collaborate with Data Scientists, Embedded Engineers, and Product Managers to ensure smooth integration of complex features and capabilities</li> <li><strong>Drive automation and reliability.</strong> You'll implement infrastructure to silently test candidate models on production devices and build telemetry pipelines to monitor drift, thermal impact, and inference latency in the wild.</li> <li><strong>Solve complex physical challenges.</strong> You'll tackle the unique constraints of the edge - building resilient update mechanisms for low-bandwidth environments, optimising for limited storage, and ensuring devices recover gracefully from network failures.</li> <li><strong>Mentor and lead.</strong> You'll share your expertise to establish best practices in Python tooling, Infrastructure-as-Code, and CI/CD, guiding the team toward a more robust, automated future.</li> </ul> <h2>Location</h2> <p>We'd like to hire someone for this role who lives near our offices in London or Barcelona, but we're also open to remote candidates in

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.description: <p><strong>Job Title: </strong>Maintenance Technician</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Smart parc, Spondon, Derby DE21 7HW</p> <p><strong>Shift Pattern: </strong>Suez Shift Pattern rotating&nbsp;days and nights, 0600-1800 and 1800-0600.</p> <p><strong>Let's Discuss What's On The Table For You:</strong></p> <ul> <li>● 70% off HelloFresh or Green Chef boxes<br>● Company pension scheme<br>● Gym membership<br>● Bupa private medical insurance (including dental &amp; family cover options)<br>● Mental health first aiders and an employee assistance programme<br>● Nursery support scheme<br>● Cycle to work scheme<br>● Group Life Assurance</li> </ul> <p>Play a key part in supporting our Employee Resource Groups: FreshVets, Black Heritage Network, NEU Network (Neurodiversity), GET (Gender Equality Team) and FreshPride</p> <p><strong>About The Job:</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Maintenance Technician to be responsible for fixing, maintaining and improving our equipment on site to make sure everything is working as it should at all times.</p> <p>The Maintenance Tech will be responsible for completing reactive and preventative works across the site, reporting defects to contractors, assisting contractors, keeping up to date on defect tickets raised on our CMMS system and following the sites Health and Safety rules.</p> <p><strong>What You Will Be Doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Perform planned preventative maintenance (PPM) on plant and equipment, including automated conveying systems, gravity conveying systems with label applicators scanners, thermoforming equipment, refrigeration plant (CO2), hi-speed roller doors, dock levellers</li> <li>Identify defects that arise while completing PPMs and undertake rectifications, recording actions taken in the maintenance manual and CMMS system.</li> <li>Conduct minor structural and electrical improvement works.</li> <li>Provide reactive support when required, including breakdown response, and ensure high standards and timely completion of work.</li> <li>Supervise contractors to ensure works are completed in accordance with the specification, and report any issues with contractors to maintenance manager.</li> <li>Comply with all Health and Safety requirements of the site at all times.</li> <li>Work proactively with maintenance shift manager to manage task volumes, provide regular updates on task status, and identify problems with plant efficiency and determine rectification measures.</li> <li>Support operational projects on an ad-hoc basis.</li> <li>Flag low stock levels to jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time. 360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue. We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for. “Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach. Within 1 month, you will: Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end Within 3 months, you will: Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up Within 6 months, you will: Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting Within 12 months, you will: Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope Have eliminated long lived credentials on the critical paths, so engineering teams ship on secure defaults they did not have to think about The Skill Set: 5+ years in infrastructure, cloud or platform engineering with a strong security focus, or in security engineering with hands on infrastructure practice Production experience with Kubernetes: RBAC, network policies, admission controllers, secrets handling, workload identity, runtime security Solid cloud experience, ideally Azure. Strong AWS or Google Cloud experience with a genuine interest in converting works too Infrastructure as code: Terraform, GitOps workflows, CI/CD pipelines Scripting and automation: Python or Go, plus shell. Comfortable reading and writing code, and opening pull requests on repositories owned by other teams Log analysis and investigation: cloud audit logs, query languages, correlation across identity, network and application sources Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).  Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L What we offer: Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈 Benefits/Perks : Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent.

jobs.title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
jobs.description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée&nbsp; en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit&nbsp; de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible

jobs.description: OVERVIEW Formance builds programmable financial infrastructure. Our open-source ledger helps engineering teams model, track, and reconcile money movements across financial products, from payment platforms to fintech applications and digital-asset businesses. Financial infrastructure requires precision. Teams need to understand where money is, how it moves, and whether their systems reflect what actually happened. We build the tools to help them answer those questions. YOUR ROLE We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer with a strong technical foundation and experience in fintech or payments to join our team. You’ll work with prospective customers to understand their architecture, map their financial flows, and demonstrate how Formance fits their requirements. You’ll partner closely with our sales, product, and engineering teams throughout the evaluation process. This role combines technical depth with commercial judgment. You should be comfortable building a proof of concept, discussing architectural tradeoffs with an engineer, and explaining the business implications to a founder. WHAT YOU’LL DO Lead technical discovery with engineering and product teams to understand their financial workflows, constraints, and evaluation criteria. Build tailored demos and proofs of concept using Formance’s APIs and tooling. Guide technical evaluations, investigate questions, and help prospects assess product fit. Partner with sales to connect technical capabilities to business needs and move opportunities forward. Bring customer feedback to product and engineering, with concrete examples of gaps and recurring needs. REQUIREMENTS Experience in fintech, payments, banking infrastructure, or digital-asset infrastructure. You understand how money moves through a financial product and the operational challenges involved. A strong technical foundation. You can work with APIs, read and write code, debug integrations, and reason about data models and system architecture. Experience working directly with customers , through solutions engineering, solutions architecture, technical consulting, or an engineering role with significant customer exposure. The ability to ask precise questions, uncover requirements, and explain complex concepts clearly. Commercial judgment: you understand how a technical evaluation contributes to a buying decision. A hands-on approach and the ability to work independently in a small team. Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to lead technical conversations with international customers. Useful additional experience Working with ledgers, double-entry accounting, reconciliation, or payment orchestration. Supporting technical evaluations for API-first or developer-facing products. Building financial workflows involving multiple currencies, payment providers, or digital assets. Turning recurring customer questions into reusable demos, documentation, or tools. WHY JOIN FORMANCE? You’ll work directly with teams building financial products and help them make consequential infrastructure decisions. You’ll have ownership of technical evaluations, close access to product and engineering, and the opportunity to shape how we demonstrate and explain Formance. Your work will influence both customer decisions and the product we build. Meal vouchers: €10 per day worked, with 55% covered by Formance. Equipment: A MacBook from day one, plus a €500 onboarding budget for your workspace equipment. Parenthood support: Formance maintains 100% of your salary during the first month of additional birth leave. Company offsite: An annual company offsite, fully organized and covered by Formance. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally. Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance : software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies. Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US. We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure. Role Overview We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Product Director to help define and build the next generation of Dotfile. You will work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Design and our customers to turn complex compliance problems into simple, powerful product experiences. You will own major areas of the product end-to-end: understanding the problem, designing the system, prototyping solutions, shipping with Engineering, and learning from how customers use them. This is a builder role. You will be expected to go deep into workflows, data models and technical constraints, work directly with engineers and designers, and prototype ideas yourself when that is the fastest way to move forward. You should care as much about how the underlying system works as you do about the user experience built on top of it. AI is at the core of Dotfile’s product. You will design systems where agents investigate, reason and act across complex compliance workflows, and use AI extensively in your own work to research, prototype and ship faster. You will lead a small Product team while remaining deeply involved in the work yourself. You will coach and develop the people on your team, raise the bar for product thinking and execution, and create the environment for them to do their best work. This is not a role where management means stepping away from the product. You will work directly with the CEO and CTO. You will be a hands-on manager - present in the detail, close to the numbers, and invested in each person's development. You are expected to make the team work: holding the cadence, removing blockers, running the pipeline, and making sure activity translates into results. We serve independent hoteliers across Europe: family hotels, boutique properties, and small chains that have long been underserved by technology designed for large chains. You will be leading people who sell something that genuinely makes a difference for hotel owners. This is a newly created role opening our first commercial hub in France. jobs.title: Research Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Research Engineer, Manipulation Data & Teleoperation — Zurich This role owns the data generation layer of Sereact's VLA stack: teleoperation systems and data collection infrastructure that feed Cortex, built from our Zurich research hub. About Sereact Sereact is a Series B embodied-AI company. Cortex, our VLA model, is deployed in live warehouse robotic cells across the EU and US. Zurich is our newest research hub, focused on the manipulation and control problems that sit underneath Cortex. The role This is a Research Engineer position. It is scoped to the data generation layer of the VLA stack: teleoperation hardware and software, retargeting pipelines that map human demonstrations onto robot hands, and the data collection infrastructure that feeds Cortex. It requires building the systems that produce the data those models train on, and working closely with the training team on what that data needs to look like. What you'll do Build and operate teleoperation systems for dexterous manipulation, including retargeting algorithms that map human hand and arm motion onto robot end-effectors Design and maintain scalable, UMI-style data collection hardware and software that other engineers at Sereact rely on Benchmark control and retargeting approaches using rigorous, human-factors-informed methodology Instrument and support the physical robots deployed in the Zurich hub, including day-to-day work on the control stack Work with the model-training team to define what data they need and close the loop on data quality Build tooling or infrastructure outside your immediate brief when it unblocks the wider team What you'll bring MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes Comfortable working as an individual contributor in a small, still-forming team Nice to have A conference submission on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting where the candidate is an author (an MSc thesis submitted to a venue like CoRL counts; supervising a student team whose own work was later published does not) Teaching or TA experience in a robotics course Some exposure to large-model training, even without an independent training record A concrete example of building something outside the formal role brief because the team needed it Location: Zurich Area, Switzerland: This role is based in our Zurich office, offering a vibrant ecosystem for robotics and AI. What We Offer: Free meals at the workplace. Flexible working hours and the option to work from home when needed. Direct collaboration with founders and world-leading AI experts. Access to large-scale compute clusters and proprietary robotic datasets. A key role in shaping the future of embodied AI. Competitive compensation and a relocation package for the Zurich area Find Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career. Driving Revenue Growth and Strategic Client Expansion As a Senior Client Partner, you will play a key role in driving commercial growth and expanding Aleph's footprint in Switzerland, directly contributing to revenue generation, portfolio expansion, and long-term strategic client partnerships. You will own a book of business, identify new growth opportunities, and position Aleph as a strategic partner within the Swiss digital advertising ecosystem. Proactively generate new leads, build a robust sales pipeline, and maintain accurate CRM records of all sales activities. Lead onboarding processes for new clients, including guiding them through legal and compliance requirements. Introduce Aleph to new prospects and expand presence across target industries. Collaborate closely with Client Solutions Managers (Account Managers) to ensure smooth campaign launches and execution. Provide timely, actionable feedback to clients to optimize performance and strengthen relationships. Strong understanding of the Swiss advertising ecosystem, with an established network across key industry players and stakeholders, particularly within media agencies, as well as advertisers and publishers. Strong commercial skills, with direct responsibility for revenue. Direct experience in paid search advertising (SEM), performance advertising, and e-commerce. jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description: Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. What We Want to Achieve Together In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. Why us? R

jobs.title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
jobs.description: Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale. We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does. Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place. Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published. Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you. 1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. jobs.title: Production Engineer
jobs.description: <p>As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.</p> <p>This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. jobs.title: Content Editor
jobs.description: Why work at Higgsfield AI? Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $700M in annual revenue run rate, 30M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We write a lot, and it's read by millions of people around the world. Our content team is already strong, and now we want to make it stronger. Kollaboration & Kommunikation: Du siehst Entwickler und Designer nicht als "Ressourcen", sondern als Partner. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. To Join Our Team, You Should Be Excited To: Build and lead the logistics team and warehouse operations, providing both functional and disciplinary leadership. To keep products moving, ensure reliable day-to-day logistics operations across domestic and international transportation, shipping and distribution, taking a hands-on approach where needed. Develop and optimize processes across warehousing, receiving, inventory, transportation, shipping and production support. Drive initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, cost performance and delivery reliability, like our SAP S/4HANA rollout, establishing RASIC and best practices to building the team and capabilities needed for future growth. Work closely with internal stakeholders across production, engineering, procurement and other business functions to ensure a reliable flow of materials and information. jobs.title: (Senior) Go to Market Scaling Manager - Germany (m/f/d)
jobs.description: 1KOMMA5° At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it? We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia. Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. Learn about our Product & Tech team! Deine Position Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the ( Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential. You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero. You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it. You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running. You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite. You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements. You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action. You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving. You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy. Dein Profil You bring at least 5 years of experience in a similar commercial, product, or GTM role, ideally within the tech and energy industry. You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance. You are structured by default and follow through without being asked: you manage multiple concurrent initiatives and dependencies without losing the thread, and own action items end to end. You are ambitious and impact-driven, yet humble and a strong influencer in equal measure. You set a high bar for what "good" looks like, quickly credit the team and admit when something isn't working, and can bring sceptical stakeholders on board to inspire the cross-functional effort to scale the German market. You have a strong grasp of unit economics and a genuine passion for how they drive monetisation decisions, and you can translate margin and cost-structure insights into concrete pricing and product strategy.

Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. The Dealer Resolutions role is on the front line when dealing with high-risk complaints from dealers that require cross-department collaboration. You will be right there resolving complex dealer issues, providing exceptional support, and helping us improve what we do by collaborating across different departments to prevent potential reputational risk. A Dealer Resolutions Specialist will own complex cases from start to finish, handle formal complaints, and provide dedicated support to the dealer throughout the cases' journey, including managing business-critical issues escalated to the C-suite. What you’ll be doing: High-Stakes Escalation Management: Own and resolve the most complex, sensitive, and high-emotion dealer escalations from intake to final resolution, serving as the definitive point of contact for aggrieved parties. Incident Response Coordination: Lead the immediate response to critical service incidents or systemic failures, orchestrating cross-functional communication to ensure impacted customers are managed with transparency, speed, and care. Strategic Goodwill Administration: Exercise autonomous judgment in awarding Gestures of Goodwill (GoGs), financial compensation, or fee waivers, balancing customer retention with commercial viability and internal policy frameworks. Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement: Transform negative feedback into operational intelligence by analyzing complaint data and trend patterns, partnering with leadership to implement process changes that eliminate future friction points. Compliance & Audit Readiness: Ensure all final responses and case documentation strictly adhere to regulatory guidelines, industry compliance standards, and tight internal Service Level Agreements (SLAs). At Venture Café, we aim to create a global community of innovators with equal access to resources and opportunities, addressing our most pressing challenges. Ready to make an impact with us? The Venture Café Global Institute (VCGI) seeks a strategic, dynamic, and self-driven Director to lead Venture Café London in the heart of the Knowledge Quarter. We are a neutral and trusted center of gravity that connects the entire innovation ecosystem and is available for everyone.  Our flagship program, the Thursday Gathering, is a dynamic and intentionally designed experience freely accessible to all. jobs.title: Software Architect - Tracking
jobs.description: This is the senior computer vision engineering authority for Hawk-Eye's tracking technology, and it is an individual contributor role. Our tracking sits underneath almost everything Hawk-Eye sells. Goal-line technology, semi-automated offside, electronic line calling, automated ball-strike. Live and post-game data. It runs across football, baseball, tennis, American football, ice hockey, cricket, basketball and rugby, on-premise, in the cloud and increasingly on edge devices, delivered by over 100 engineers in the Tracking and Automated Officiating value stream. You would be the person who decides how that is built. The role carries two hats. As Software Architect you own the software-level architectural design across tracking, auto-officiating and data delivery. As computer vision authority you lead the core domains: camera calibration, ball tracking, skeletal tracking, and the R&D that feeds them. It is a hands-on job. You set architecture for new tracking problems as they arrive, you safeguard the shared frameworks, and when a live delivery is at risk you are the escalation point who gets into the code. What you would own Architecture across the value stream. You are the lead architect for every tracking and auto-officiating product in T&AO. You set the initial architecture when a new tracking problem enters the business, run the Software Domain Owner model so shared libraries like calibration have named codeowners, and keep designs consistent across sports. You represent tracking in the Engineering Architecture Steering group and feed into architecture conversations across Hawk-Eye and the wider Sony Sports organisation. Part of that is judgement about reuse. Keeping value streams on a common tracking codebase pays off until it doesn't, and knowing where that line sits is the job. Computer vision direction. You are the subject matter authority. You decide where our vision processing and ML integration goes next, research new tracking technologies and bring them in, and build prototypes when a proposal needs proving rather than describing. Modern tooling, properly evaluated. We want agentic coding frameworks, LLM-driven development tools and automated code generation working inside heavy C++ and Python codebases, with guidelines that hold up. You would lead that adoption and decide what earns its place. Growing other engineers. You coach the Squad Tech Leads, guide junior architects, and run CV Algorithm talks, HawkTalks and tutorials. You also help us hire well, including technical assessment for CV and ML roles. The awkward bits. Operational health of ML training and synthetic data infrastructure sits with you, including escalating the gaps in ownership and support with options attached. What we are looking for The core of it is deep multi-camera computer vision. Camera calibration including intrinsics, extrinsics, distortion models, anti-wobble and bundle adjustment. Triangulation. 3D ball and pose estimation, skeletal tracking, continuous-time modelling, inverse kinematics. On top of that: Expert cross-platform C++ across Windows and Linux, x86 and ARM, with CMake and real performance profiling ability Strong working knowledge of GPU inference (TensorRT, Triton) and ML pipelines (PyTorch, ONNX) Proven experience running tracking at scale in AWS, on-premise and on edge devices Hands-on use of AI coding agents and LLM orchestration to accelerate algorithm R&D and refactoring in large codebases A working understanding of generative AI, synthetic data generation and where they genuinely help real-time CV The parts that are harder to put in a bullet point. You can set architecture across many squads and sports and make pragmatic calls on reuse, cost and time to market. You write clearly: design documents, proposals with options, explanations a non-technical stakeholder can follow. You are comfortable in front of external engineering partners, which here means Sony, NVIDIA and AWS alongside sports leagues and fede
