jobs.description: Location: Oxford or London (Hybrid) The Mission: Why We Exist Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer, healthier lives, using the power of genomics. Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores - giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time. Role Purpose Genomic data is some of the most sensitive data there is, and our customers trust us with it. As Senior Application Security Engineer on Mystra, you'll own application security end-to-end across multi-tenant, trillion-row-scale, AI-enabled data platforms. You'll lead threat modelling and design review with product teams, build the tooling and patterns that make secure codet, and find and fix the vulnerabilities that slip through. You'll do it with security-focused AI tooling, steered by your own expert judgement and intuition, to keep Genomics secure against state-of-the-art threats. A Day in the Life Leading threat modelling and design reviews for new products and infrastructure, and defining the security invariants every team builds against: tenant isolation, authentication and authorisation, secrets, least privilege, and trust boundaries Building the libraries, patterns, and CI/CD guardrails that make the secure way the easy way, and deciding what is enforced versus advised Building and tuning AI tooling for code analysis, triage, and remediation, and deciding where its output can be trusted and where it must be verified Hunting for vulnerabilities through code review, testing, and proof-of-concept exploits, then running the disclosure programme and driving every finding through to a verified fix Securing our agentic and AI surfaces, from prompt injection and tool boundaries to delegated credentials and tenant-scoped access, and proving the controls hold under adversarial testing Working as an embedded, trusted partner to product teams, SRE, detection and response, the data platform team, and the MystraAI / ML team, unblocking rather than gating Who You Are Experience within application security in production. You've found and fixed exploitable bugs in software you were responsible for, through threat modelling, secure design, code review, and proof-of-concept exploitation across web services, APIs, and data-serving interfaces. Triaging scanner output doesn't count Production-quality software engineering in at least one mainstream language (such as Python, Go, or TypeScript), and you can read several. You've built and operated security or developer tooling in CI/CD pipelines, such as static and dependency analysis, secrets detection, or policy-as-code, and engineers actually adopted it Hands-on depth securing multi-tenant systems on a major cloud. We run on AWS (RDS, EC2, S3, EKS, Batch), and comparable GCP or Azure depth transfers. You've built or tuned LLM-driven tooling rather than only used a chat interface, and you understand the attack surface it introduces Experience running, or being core to, a vulnerability disclosure or bug bounty programme and the remediation lifecycle behind it, covering severity, prioritisation, SLAs, root cause, and systemic fixes. jobs.description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Sujet de stage Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure : Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple) Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat Et d'autres fonctionnalités ! Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Il ou elle rejoindra l’équipe Jobexit et participera également au chapter web (regroupement de tous les développeurs fullstack de l’entreprise).   Les à-côtés du poste 👁️ Le ou la stagiaire participera comme tous les ingénieurs à son chapter (réuni 2 fois par mois) dont le but est de : Partager des connaissances entre ses membres (amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques) Proposer des améliorations (nouveaux outils et processus) Aider ses membres en fonction de leurs besoins Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝 Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert. Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. jobs.description: <h1>Stage Data Quality Operations (x/f/m)</h1> <h2>Rejoignez notre mission, rejoignez Doctolib !</h2> <p>Nous recherchons un(e) <strong>stagiaire Data Quality Operations</strong> pour rejoindre l’équipe en charge de la qualité des données des praticiens à <strong>Levallois-Perret</strong>.</p> <p>Chez Doctolib, nous mettons l’intelligence artificielle et la technologie au service d’une santé plus accessible et de meilleure qualité. En rejoignant l’équipe en charge de la qualité des données des praticiens, vous contribuerez à fiabiliser les informations utilisées dans Salesforce et à soutenir nos opérations sur plusieurs marchés européens.</p> <p>En tant que <strong>stagiaire Data Quality Operations</strong>, votre mission sera de contrôler et d’améliorer la qualité des données des praticiens dans Salesforce. Vous contribuerez à maintenir une data fiable grâce à des opérations d’import, de nettoyage, de mise en forme, de reporting et d’automatisation. Vous collaborerez avec différentes parties prenantes afin de faire évoluer les processus et d’améliorer la performance des opérations en France, en Allemagne, en Italie et au Royaume-Uni.</p> <h2>Vos missions</h2> <p>Vos responsabilités incluent, mais ne sont pas limitées à :</p> <ul> <li>Contrôler la qualité des données des praticiens dans Salesforce sur les marchés français, allemand, italien et jobs.title: Payroll Specialist
jobs.description: About Ledger We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger. At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries. The team: You're joining as we reshape the People & Operations Experience team, which brings together ops, payroll, people tech, engagement and internal comms. That makes this a build-and-run role. You'll run payroll from day one and help design how the function works going forward, from processes to tooling to documentation. The role You'll take ownership of French payroll, starting with a proper handover from the colleague who runs it today and building towards running it independently. Alongside it, you'll look after the employee lifecycle: joiners, leavers and everything in between. It's real responsibility, with a team around you. Your development goes in two directions: continuous improvement of how People Ops works, and a progressive move into Global Payroll (US, UK, Singapore) as your confidence and scope grow. Your arrival also creates room for the whole team to take on bigger things, and that includes you. What you'll do Own French payroll Run the full monthly cycle: data collection, absences and leave, inputs, controls, validation and payslip checks Prepare and submit statutory filings on time (URSSAF, DSN, IJSS/Net-entreprise and other mandatory declarations) Manage variable pay and contractual changes, and build the VPI file for ADP Decidium Work with Finance on transfer files, cost reporting, headcount tracking and variance analysis Handle day to day equity payroll declarations (stock options / BSPCE) as you slowly build your expertise Manage benefits, meal vouchers and provider relationships Track regulatory changes and turn them into better processes Run the employee lifecycle Handle joiners and leavers: contracts, health insurance and transport registration, visa and absence data Keep Workday data accurate and compliant Help document and improve the processes being rebuilt, and contribute to cross-functional People projects You'll work with Finance, Talent Acquisition, HRBPs, C&B and our provider ADP. What you bring 2–3 years of French payroll experience, with hands-on exposure to the monthly cycle and a readiness to own it Solid knowledge of French social legislation (URSSAF, DSN) and experience with a payroll tool (ADP or similar) Rigour: you close the month on time, without being chased A builder's instinct: you document as you go and like making things work better Comfort working in English in a multicultural team Curiosity about international payroll and a real appetite to widen your scope At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits

jobs.title: Technical Lead - AI Ops
jobs.description: At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! The Role Brevo is transforming all of its operations to become AI native: We are redefining the way we work internally, the way we consume data (analytical and operational), the way we interact with each other. From customer support teams to RevOps, from Analytical engineer to finance team, all our jobs will be transformed and we becoming manages of agents. The AI Ops team drives this transformation: it builds and operates AI agents, applications, and the associated tooling, in production. We bring impact at high speed. We're looking for a Tech Lead to set the technical direction of AI Ops and lead the engineers who build it. You'll own the architecture of our agent platform and raise the bar on how we ship, while staying hands-on in the code. This is not a research-oriented role: we're looking for a builder with experience making systems work in production. Why join us ? A rare, AI-native playground: make a profitable scale-up's operations AI-native, with agents in production and visible weekly impact, backed by best-in-class tools (Claude, internal agentic tooling, dedicated observability) and an AI-assisted engineering culture. A fast paced organisation able to redefine itself quicker than any other Real autonomy: define problems with business teams, own solutions through to production. Your Impact at Brevo: Design, build, and operate AI agents in production. Integrate internal data to build relevant context accurately and in a controlled way (context engineering). Discover needs directly with business teams (CX, RevOps, Data), hand agents over in forward-deployed-engineer mode, and contribute to the architectural vision of the agent platform. Own the architecture of the solutions we build, and make the key technical decisions (multi-agent design, pre-processing, deterministic routing, LLM-as-judge, observability, human in the loop surface of interaction) Own deployment and operations: CI/CD, sandbox/production environments, monitoring, and agent observability. Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, evals, testing, and deployment. Make sure the team follows them. Mentor and grow the engineers on the team Who you are: Must-have: Proven tech lead experience: you've set the technical direction for a team, made architecture calls, and mentored engineers. Whole-system thinker: you challenge architecture decisions and weigh the business impact of technical choices. Comfortable with ambiguity: you turn a fuzzy problem into a shipped solution without a pre-written spec, and help your team do the same. DevOps-fluent: end-to-end deployment, infra-as-code, and debugging network environments (VPN, proxies). Agents & LLMs: hands-on experience shipping agents to production (ADK, LangChain, or similar), including applied prompt engineering and evaluation. You build with AI daily (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent) and push the team to do the same. Fluent in

jobs.title: Senior Demande Generation Manager
jobs.description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.   Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics.    The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F   ollow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. About the role Scality is looking for an experienced Demand Generation Campaign Manager to own our global campaign program. You plan, launch, and optimize the campaigns that generate qualified leads and opportunities across our enterprise and mid-market go to market in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific.   This is a hands-on role for a marketer who thinks strategically. You take a pipeline target, decide how to reach it, and run the campaigns that get there. You hold yourself to the numbers: leads and opportunities generated, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and channel efficiency. Most of the work is digital. You also run the campaigns around our webinars, trade shows, and partner programs, from promotion to lead follow up.   The main challenge is generating demand in a market that is changing fast. Buyers increasingly get their information from AI tools rather than the channels marketers have relied on, and gated content and volume downloads are losing their effect. This role needs the creativity to build demand where the old playbooks no longer work. You own the campaign function in an international marketing team. You work closely with the Head of Growth, who runs paid media, SEO, and web, and with marketing operations and nurture. You work with the AMER field marketing manager and the EMEA regional marketing team on campaigns for their events and partner programs, and with product marketing on messaging and assets. You also work with sales, SDR, and partner teams in every region. What you will be doing Own the global campaign plan and calendar, translating pipeline targets into integrated campaigns across paid social, paid search, email, webinars, content syndication, and account-based marketing Take each campaign from brief to launch: audience and targeting, offer, messaging with product marketing, landing pages and forms, promotion, lead routing, and reporting Run campaigns for webinars, trade shows, field events, and partner programs, from promotion before the event to lead follow up after Run the thought leadership and customer webinar program, from topic and speakers to registration, delivery, and follow up Work with the Head of Growth on paid media strategy, spend allocation, and experimentation across LinkedIn, Google, and new channels Build campaigns with marketing operations in HubSpot and Salesforce, and own campaign structure, naming, and attribution in Salesforce Own weekly and monthly lead generation reporting to marketing and executive leadership: leads and opportunities against goal, conversion by stage, cost per lead and per opportunity, and spend by channel and region Align with sales and SDR teams across regions on lead handoff, follow up, and pipeline acceleration Manage campaign budgets and agencies, and prioritize spend against pipeline impact Run experiments across audiences, offers, and channels to improve conversion and lower acquisition cost What you bring to the table Ten years or

jobs.title: Quantum Information Scientist - Architecture & Performance
jobs.description: About Quandela: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions Our ambition is to build large-scale fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of solving problems beyond the reach of classical computation.  Getting there will require several generations of intermediate architectures. Choosing the right ones means understanding what can be built, what these systems can compute and how efficiently they can do so. About this position: You will join Quandela’s Quantum Information team within Architecture , working on the evaluation and design of our near- and mid-term quantum architectures.  Your role will sit between quantum theory, computational capability and real hardware constraints . You will develop methods to evaluate architecture concepts, understand their performance and limitations, and help guide future architecture choices. Depending on your background, you may draw on complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, benchmarking or related areas . You will work closely with our Device Physics, FTQC and Q.Algorithms Team. Requirements What you'll do: As a Quantum Information Scientist working on Architecture & Performance, you will:  Evaluate and compare the capabilities and limitations of near- and mid-term quantum architectures.  Draw on methods from complexity theory, benchmarking, characterisation and related fields to assess different architecture designs.  Incorporate realistic noise, native operations and physical constraints into your analyses.  Investigate when and how different architectures could provide meaningful computational capabilities or advantages.  Develop scientific models and numerical tools to explore architecture-performance trade-offs.  Study how architecture choices interact with algorithms, resource requirements and QEC strategies.  Progressively propose and lead new research projects around architecture design and performance.  You will work across our Architecture team and Algorithms and Applications team, connecting questions from the physical layer to computational capability and potential applications.  - How you'll grow: During your first 3–6 months  Become familiar with Quandela’s technologies, architecture roadmap and ongoing research while contributing to existing evaluation and performance studies.  Within 1 year  Take increasing ownership of architecture studies, compare different concepts and bring your own scientific perspective to the team.  Longer term  Lead exploratory research projects, propose new architecture directions and contribute to shaping Quandela’s future architecture roadmap. -- What we're looking for: We are looking for a scientist with a strong theoretical background in quantum computing, scientific autonomy and an interest in connecting different layers of the quantum-computing stack. Must-have  PhD in Quantum Information, Quantum Computing, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science or a closely related field.  Strong expertise in one or more relevant areas, such as quantum complexity theory, quantum learning theory, quantum-system characterisation, performance analysis or

jobs.description: About Agicap Créée à Lyon en 2016 par trois entrepreneurs français, Agicap est l'une des scale-ups avec la plus forte croissance d’Europe, avec plus de 8 000 clients, 600 employés et une croissance rapide du chiffre d'affaires (multiplié par 7 entre 2021 et 2024). Agicap fait partie du French Tech 120, qui récompense les startups les plus prometteuses de France. Agicap permet aux directions financières des entreprises de taille intermédiaire de gérer et de prévoir efficacement leur trésorerie, de payer leurs fournisseurs et de se faire payer. En combinant un système de gestion de trésorerie avec des solutions de gestion des comptes fournisseurs et des comptes clients sur une seule plateforme, Agicap ambitionne de devenir la nouvelle référence en matière de gestion de trésorerie pour les entreprises de taille intermédiaire. Nous avons levé 145 millions d’euros depuis notre création, auprès de fonds de capital-risque prestigieux tels qu’AVP, Greenoaks, Partech et BlackFin, avec un dernier tour en novembre 2024. Ces ressources supplémentaires alimentent encore davantage notre innovation produit, nous permettant de croître significativement et d’accélérer notre expansion internationale à travers le monde. Nous sommes convaincus que notre succès réside dans nos équipes passionnées et dévouées, engagées à bâtir une entreprise où chacun peut évoluer et construire sa carrière. Nous sommes constamment à la recherche de nouveaux talents, visant l’excellence et prêts à rejoindre notre aventure ambitieuse ! Home page Customer Stories Our Values ⚡️ Le rôle Agicap est en pleine phase de scale-up : nous signons chaque mois de nombreux nouveaux clients, et développer et fidéliser nos clients existants est désormais tout aussi important. L'expansion et le churn font partie des premiers indicateurs suivis par notre board. En tant que Key Account Manager, vous êtes responsable d'un portefeuille d'environ 150 comptes mid-market : des entreprises de plus de 50 M€ de chiffre d'affaires, souvent des groupes multi-entités, des sociétés en hypercroissance ou détenues par des fonds de private equity. Vous travaillez avec des DAF, directeur·rices financier·ères, trésorier·ères, responsables comptables et parfois des CEO. Ce qui rend ce poste unique : vous apportez une vraie expertise en trésorerie. Vous ne vous contentez pas de comprendre les enjeux des équipes finance (maîtriser les prévisions de trésorerie, améliorer la performance financière, assurer la gestion quotidienne des paiements et de la liquidité, gérer la relation bancaire, intégrer et piloter toutes les entités d'un groupe) : vous savez les challenger. Vous êtes un·e véritable conseiller·ère de confiance pour vos clients. Vous rejoignez une équipe de 7 KAM qui a obtenu d'excellents résultats cette année, avec un fort esprit d'équipe et des objectifs ambitieux. 🎯 Vos missions 🤝 Construire des relations solides avec les décideur·ses finance Instaurer une relation de confiance avec les décideur·ses de vos comptes et cartographier toutes les parties prenantes clés, souvent sur plusieurs entités Comprendre leur contexte business, leur organisation trésorerie, leurs process et leurs priorités, et les challenger avec les bonnes pratiques adaptées Gérer les frictions et les situations complexes avec assurance 📈 Développer votre portefeuille Définir et piloter une stratégie de développement pour chaque compte : upsell, renouvellement, contrats pluriannuels, recommandation Identifier de nouvelles opportunités : nouvelles entités, nouveaux cas d'usage, évolutions dans l'organisation ou le contexte business du client Mener des découvertes et des démos produit centrées sur les cas d'usage trésorerie, construire des business cases et négocier les offres Porter vos objectifs mensuels d'expansion et de rétention 📊 Démontrer la valeur et sécuriser la rétention Animer des Executive Business Reviews (EBR) pour vous aligner sur les enjeux stratégiques du client et mesurer son retour sur investissement Détecte

jobs.title: Sales Representative (m/w/d) - St. Gallen
jobs.description: Du hast erste Vertriebserfahrung und willst jetzt richtig loslegen? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Onboarding, dein eigenes Gebiet, kurze Sales-Cycles und ein Team, das dich weiterentwickelt. Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software – von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen. Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70% weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche. Deine Rolle Du verantwortest das Wachstum in deiner Region und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson vor Ort Du gehst aktiv auf Saloninhaber:innen in deiner Region zu – telefonisch, per Walk-in oder über Social Media (Kaltakquise). Vor Ort ermittelst du den Bedarf des Salons mithilfe von Fragen und zeigst anhand von Produktdemos, wie Salonkee den Alltag vereinfachen kann. Du verantwortest deinen eigenen Funnel vom Erstkontakt bis zum Abschluss. Deine Woche planst du eigenverantwortlich, mit klaren Zielen und einer Führungskraft, die dich unterstützt und weiterentwickelt. Das bringst du mit Nachweisbare erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, idealerweise mit Outbound-Anteil (Kaltakquise, Walk-ins, eigene Terminierung). Du bist kontaktfreudig und gehst gerne in den Austausch – egal ob am Telefon oder direkt vor Ort. Du bist in der Lage, Menschen zu begeistern und Interessen zu wecken. Du kannst mit Ablehnung umgehen und richtest den Blick nach vorn. Du bist lernbereit, setzt Feedback um und willst dich weiterentwickeln. Du bist strukturiert, organisiert und sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools. Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein. Das erwartet dich bei uns Ein Team vor Ort: Team Lead und Kolleg:innen in deiner Region – du startest nicht allein. Strukturierte Einarbeitung und praxisnahe Begleitung über die ersten Monate hinweg (Ramp-Up Programm). Ein klarer Entwicklungspfad : Von Junior über Senior bis hin zu Führungsrollen. Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst. Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit. Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone. 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio. Fixgehalt und ungedeckelte Provision . Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate. Wie geht es weiter? Bewerbung & Sichtung – wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30–45 Minuten). Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft. Field Day – zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion. Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product. Your Background PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues. Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data. Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare. Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Reliability & Test Infrastructure)
jobs.description: Our Mission At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the path a code change takes from commit to robot, and the evidence behind every gate on that path. Today the honest answer to "is this build safe?" is "it worked on the test robot." You will replace that with a system: the simulation environment the team tests against, the regression suites that run on every change, the hardware-in-the-loop rigs, and the release gates that decide whether a build can go onto a robot that will patrol a customer site alone tonight. This is the first engineer dedicated to reliability and test infrastructure, and it sits in our Robot Autonomy team, next to the engineers building perception, localisation, planning and locomotion. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test. Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover. Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers. jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description: About Flink Flink Robotics delivers superhuman physical work. We are a Zürich-based deep tech startup developing a physics-based world model that lets machines reason about the physical world and do work robots couldn't do before - starting with logistics. We're a team of engineers and researchers with roots at ETH Zürich, backed by leading European investors. The technology is ambitious; now we want the way we look and show up to match it. The role You make Flink look as cool from the outside as it is on the inside. As our first brand & marketing hire, you own how Flink shows up to the world and help shape how it feels to work here. This is a hands-on role with a lot of ownership from day one. You'll work directly with the CEO and the whole team, and you'll have real freedom to set the tone. We care more about taste, energy and drive than years of experience; junior profiles are very welcome. What you'll do Own our look and feel. Evolve and guard Flink's visual identity. Logo use, colours, typography, photo and video style: and make sure everything we put out is consistent. Run our website. Keep flink.so fresh, fast and on-message: new pages, news, job posts, visuals. Work with freelancers or agencies where needed. Build our social presence. Plan and create content for LinkedIn and other channels. Robot footage, behind-the-scenes, team stories, milestones and grow an audience that gets excited about what we do. Run marketing campaigns. Turn our story into campaigns, from product launches and trade fair pushes to customer and recruiting campaigns. You own the creative and the message, and work closely with the Growth team on goals, audiences and channels. Tell our story visually. Create or coordinate photos, videos, graphics and animations of our robots and technology. Support pitch decks, investor updates and sales materials so they look world-class. Organise events. From trade fairs and demo days to meetups, customer visits and team events. Plan them, run them and make them memorable. Make our space amazing. Shape how our office and workshop look and feel, so every visitor - investor, customer or candidate - gets the Flink vibe. Strengthen our employer brand. Help us attract top engineers: careers page, job ads, recruiting content, how candidates experience Flink. Bring the brand inside. Help build team culture through internal communication, onboarding touches, swag; you name it. What you bring A strong eye for design and visuals: you know what looks great. Creativity and ideas of your own: you don't wait for a brief to start making things Hands-on skills in design tools (e.g. Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) and comfort creating content for social media A portfolio that shows your taste: professional, freelance, student or side projects all count Organisational talent: you can juggle an event, a website update and a video shoot in the same week Excellent written and spoken English Curiosity about technology and robotics: you don't need to be an engineer, but you want to understand what we build First experience in branding, marketing, design or communications (internships count) Nice to have German (spoken or written) Photo or video shooting and editing skills Experience with website design Interior design, set design or event production experience Previous startup or tech-company experience What we offer The chance to build a brand from the ground up at a deep tech startup on the rise Real ownership and direct access to the founders: your work is visible from day one Robots, a workshop and a story worth telling: some of the most exciting content in tech, waiting to be shown to the world A growing, ambitious team in Zürich Competitive salary and employee stock options Budget and freedom to try new ideas Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Chief of Staff
jobs.description: Overview Physical AI, a real model of the world, is the next trillion dollar opportunity and a foundational pillar for energy, robotics and superintelligence. At Jua we are building it now. Our models already run on four continents and help power the energy buildout needed to support ever larger intelligence. We are assembling a world-class team of researchers and entrepreneurial minds to turn this model into reality at global scale. If you want the opportunity of your life, come build physical AI with us. The Role You work directly with Jua’s Leadership. You operate as a force multiplier — plugging into whatever's highest-leverage that day, from fundraising and investor work to product calls, deals, and fixing what's broken before it slows us down. What you're pulled into will shift as the business does — some stretches this is heavily fundraising and investor-facing, others it's operational firefighting or unsticking a cross-functional project. The pace is high, the context load is real, and you'll see everything. This is also a launchpad into an executive leadership role. This role is best suited for someone who has been an early-stage operator or ex-founder, and has hands-on experience with start-ups that are still in the build-phase. If that's you, expect a founder's vantage point on how Jua scales — the pace and stakes of building it yourself, without carrying it alone. What You Will Do Problem-solve directly with the leadership team on the highest-leverage issues across the business — from product, marketing and operations to fundraising and partnerships. Sit in high-stakes meetings with customers, investors, and strategic partners, and turn what happens there into clear next steps. Bring clarity to priorities and make sure decisions actually turn into action. Build lightweight dashboards and operating rhythms that help the team learn from data that's still evolving — without pretending it's cleaner than it is. Be the glue across the business: spot where cross-functional work is stuck and personally unblock it — including outside your core areas, whether that's a marketing crunch, a vendor issue, or whatever's fallen through the cracks. Write sharp briefs, investor materials, and internal notes. Handle practical execution when it matters — travel, schedules, logistics, on-site coordination. Who You Are A fast learner who can switch contexts without dropping quality — the mix of what you're doing will genuinely change over time, and you're energised by that rather than needing it to settle. Real depth in one or two areas, not experience scattered thinly across many — we'd rather see two or three things you've actually driven than a long list of things you've touched. Comfortable with data and analytical tools (vibe coding is enough) — precise enough to help the team make calls on metrics that are still taking shape, without waiting for perfect numbers. A clear, concise communicator who compresses complexity. High ownership and bias toward action. Comfortable with ambiguity — figuring things out as you go — and good at building real relationships across the team to get things done through others. Challenges directly — firm, honest input with no ego or personal agenda — then backs the CEO's call fully, including the ones that don't pan out. Spots problems before anyone else does, and gets ahead of them — not just reactive once something's already stuck. A professional background in a leadership position in one of the following domains, along with cross-functional experience in other parts of the business too : Product, Commercial, People and/or Engineering. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer - Design for Cost & Product Improvement
jobs.description: As Mechanical Engineer, within Distalmotion’s Instruments – Product Improvement team, you will be responsible for driving product optimization initiatives with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, manufacturing efficiency, and continuous product improvement for the Instruments of the surgical system. The Mechanical Engineer brings solid experience in component and tooling design with associated impact analysis (impact on design verification, risk assessment, quality and manufacturing costs) and root cause investigation of clinical complaints and/or non-conformities. Tasks : Design & Cost Optimization • Specify design, prototype, and implement mechanical components and custom tooling/fixtures with a strong focus on Design for Manufacturing, Assembly and Cost (DFM/DFA/DFC). • Identify, justify and execute cost reduction opportunities on existing instruments without compromising performance, quality or safety. • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders from manufacturing of prototypes to testing and industrialization of the products. Impact analysis • Perform comprehensive impact analysis of the proposed design changes, evaluating effects on manufacturing processes, unit costs, risk management and design verification. • Evaluate financial impact of proposed design changes, including tooling/fixture investments, scrap reduction and cycle time improvement. • Define technical requirements and test protocols and ensure traceability with the design in test reports. Supervise and participate to design verification. • Collaborate with internal teams (Ops, QA, RA). • The compliance with the applicable laws and standards and the design control practices is a must (e.g. ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR 820, MDR). Continuous Improvement • Investigate clinical complaints and production non-conformity. • Lead root cause analysis and manage Corrective and Preventive Actions to drive continuous product quality and reliability improvements. Requirements Education & Experience • Mechanical, microtechnology engineering degree or equivalent (BSc or MSc) • At least 5 years of experience in the medical device industry or highly regulated environment (eg. Aerospace, automotive) Technical competency • Proficiency in CAD (SOLIDWORKS preferred) • Design For Manufacturing experience (plastic and metal injection, stamping, …), for medium to high volume manufacturing • Relevant experience in Design Control (Design input/output/transfer, Risk Analysis, Failure mode analysis) • Knowledge of change management workflows Soft Skills • Strong analytical, problem-solving, pragmatic and creative skills • Good communication skills with proactive attitude and strong accountability under limited supervision • Language: French, English Benefits What we offer : A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery. Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility. Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start. High degree of autonomy and flexibility. jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach. Read more about Design at DuckDuckGo on our blog: https://spreadprivacy.com/ethical-by-design/ About You 7+ years of experience in product or design systems roles, including 2+ years in senior-level design positions at significant global consumer brands Demonstrable track record of building and scaling complex and established systems Ability to lead the future of our design system, from audit, recommending solutions, and planning their rollout via quick wins or large-scale projects Ability to communicate recommendations and prioritization with clear documentation, success metrics, resources, and rationale which stakeholders, designers, and engineers can confidently act on A knack for balancing structure with scale by creating frameworks (tokens, libraries) that hold up across platforms and teams without sacrificing craft Deep knowledge of design tools, such as Figma, that are key to evolving and maintaining the design system Experience bridging design and engineering practices, including creating shared nomenclature and workflows that map across tools and platforms Accustomed to applying agentic and AI-driven solutions into design system management and maintenance workflows, to both accelerate and elevate how the system scales Enjoy pushing creative limits while solving challenging design problems and delivering on delight, craft and exceptional quality Ability to communicate visual and interaction recommendations with high-quality mockups, prototypes, and rationale Skills to manage ambiguity and wrangle vague problems, propose innovative solutions, and execute them with a focus on metrics Ability to take initiative in generating ideas and carrying them forward with urgency and discretion, while working openly and collaboratively Compensation $ 178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer - Autonomy Architecture
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.  Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.  Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.  The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously.  Increasingly, we also build custom hardware to adapt our machines for highly specialized, robust applications beyond traditional excavation.  About the Job The autonomy team at Gravis architects autonomous behaviors for different tasks, e.g. different types of excavation or truck loading. This role owns the architecture that lets those behaviors live in the same software stack as opposed to creating one SW stack per behavior. You'll be responsible for how tasks are decomposed and orchestrated, for the interfaces between, and for the software quality. We are looking for a senior roboticist with C++ and Python expertise and high standards for software quality, who can make clear, pragmatic architectural calls that let the system grow without losing stability. What you'll do Architecture Own the task-level architecture shared across our autonomous behaviors Define clear module boundaries and responsibilities between behavior orchestration, factor out common logic across different tasks Implement component tests and telemetry/metrics collection pipelines Identify technical debt early enough to guide the team toward sustainable solutions Act as the go-to person for software quality: modern C++ practices, code structure, error handling, robustness. We're looking for a senior IC to own the analog power chain end-to-end across our UXV platforms: from MOSFET commutation simulation through PCB layout to lab validation. You will be the technical reference on power electronics inside our Lausanne engineering hub, unblocking propulsion, airframe, and embedded teams in parallel as we scale from prototype cadence to multi-platform deployment. This is a builder role, not a research seat. You ship hardware. Responsibilities Power Stage Architecture: Lead motor-controller and DC-DC topology across fixed-wing, multicopter, and hybrid UXV platforms. Translate mission constraints into power-chain specification. MOSFET Commutation & Gate-Drive Design: Own the analog switching design: dead-time tuning, gate shaping, switching-loss vs EMI vs thermal trade-offs. Multi-fidelity Simulation: Deploy the full stack: analytical loss budgeting, transient SPICE (LTspice), system-level modelling in PLECS or Simulink. BLDC Drive Stages: Design three-phase inverters with integrated current sensing, protection, Trapezoidal and FOC-aware hardware interfaces. High-Power-Density PCBA: Lead schematic and layout in Altium or KiCad with thermal, parasitics, and EMC engineered in from the first revision. EMI / EMC Engineering: Drive pre-compliance, filter design, and root-cause debug under flight-representative loads. Lab Validation: Execute bench characterization (power analysers, oscilloscopes, thermal imaging, double-pulse testing) and reconcile against simulation. Firmware & Controls Interface: Partner with embedded and propulsion on FOC tuning, current-sense calibration, and the hardware/firmware compensation boundary. Deep working mastery of MOSFET commutation design : gate-driver selection, dead-time tuning, switching transitions, loss budgets. Proven ownership of at least one motor-controller PCBA shipped from prototype through production (or pre-production qualification) : ideally on drone, robotics, eVTOL, or automotive platforms. Fluency in simulation (LTspice, PLECS, or Simulink) and PCB design (Altium). Strong, hard-earned intuition for EMI / EMC design and debug. Lab-bench discipline: you've personally debugged what simulation missed. Comfort with scale-up iteration speed and end-to-end ownership. English fluent (working language); French is a nice-to-have, not a requirement. Bonus points for: GaN / SiC experience, safety-critical design exposure , applied control theory implemented in hardware, exposure to defense, aerospace, or UAS programmes. jobs.title: UX/UI Designer (m/w/d) SaaS & digitale Produkte
jobs.description: Über Cannaleo Digital Wir gehören zu den führenden Softwareanbietern im Bereich Medizinal Cannabis. Über 400 Apotheken nutzen bereits unsere Lösungen und mehr als 3 Millionen Bestellungen wurden über unsere Systeme verarbeitet. Wir entwickeln digitale Produkte für Apotheken, Ärzt:innen, Großhändler und weitere Partner und gestalten damit die digitale Zukunft der Medizinal-Cannabis-Versorgung. Aufgaben Deine Aufgaben: Gestaltung und Optimierung von User Interfaces: Du entwickelst und optimierst Benutzeroberflächen für unsere Web- und Mobile-Anwendungen, um ein nahtloses und ansprechendes Nutzererlebnis zu gewährleisten. Entwicklung von Wireframes, Prototypen und Design-Systemen: Du erstellst Wireframes, Prototypen und Design-Systeme, um Konzepte zu visualisieren und die Konsistenz unserer Produkte sicherzustellen. Analyse von Nutzerbedürfnissen: Du analysierst Nutzerbedürfnisse und setzt diese in nutzerfreundliche Lösungen um, die sowohl funktional als auch ästhetisch überzeugen. Usability-Tests und iteratives Design: Du führst Usability-Tests durch, um Feedback von Nutzern zu sammeln, und nutzt dieses Feedback, um Designs kontinuierlich zu optimieren. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit: Fundiertes Verständnis von User-Experience-Prinzipien und visuellem Design Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich UX/UI oder Visual Design Erfahrung mit Motion Design und interaktiven Animationen Kreativität, analytisches Denken und ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für modernes Design Kreativität und Freude an innovativer Gestaltung sowie ein gutes Gespür für aktuelle Designtrends Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit sowie eine eigenverantwortliche und strukturierte Arbeitsweise Offenheit für die umfassende Integration von Claude und Figma in den Arbeitsalltag; idealerweise bereits Erfahrung mit beiden Tools Offene und freundliche Persönlichkeit mit der Fähigkeit, konstruktiv mit Feedback und Kritik umzugehen Lösungsorientierte Herangehensweise und aktive Beteiligung an Designbesprechungen Selbstständige Arbeitsweise sowie Freude am Austausch und an der Zusammenarbeit mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Fachbereichen Benefits Das bieten wir dir Innovatives Umfeld: Wir entwickeln Softwarelösungen, die die digitale Healthcare- und Cannabis-Branche voranbringen. jobs.title: Principle Software Engineer - Product, Platform, Infrastructure
jobs.description: Help us build the future of public administration! Ayunis is a Munich-based GovTech company trusted by more than 800 cities, municipalities and districts across the DACH region. With Ayunis Core, we are building an open-source AI platform that automates repetitive administrative work. We use cutting-edge AI and engineering tools to build cutting-edge agentic technology—both for our customers and for our own development workflows. Tasks Your role As Principal Engineer, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across our product, integration platform and production infrastructure. Working closely with the CTO and engineering team, you will set technical direction, make critical architectural decisions and help other engineers deliver independently. You will remain close to code and production without becoming the bottleneck for every difficult problem. Your responsibilities Evolve the architecture of Ayunis Core across frontend, backend, agent runtime, identity, permissions and extension interfaces. Own the technical direction of our infrastructure, including deployments, reliability, observability, security and incident readiness. Build stable APIs, SDKs and reusable integration patterns for external systems such as document management systems and identity providers. Make pragmatic trade-offs between delivery speed, simplicity and long-term maintainability. Work with Product and customer-facing teams to turn recurring needs into reusable product capabilities. Collaborate with open-source contributors, software vendors and integration partners. Requirements What you bring Experience operating at Staff, Principal or a comparable level in a production software environment. Strong backend and systems architecture skills, ideally with TypeScript and Node.js. Hands-on experience with agent runtimes like LangChain, OpenAI Agent SDK, Mastra or similar. Hands-on experience with sovereign infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, scaling, observability and security. Experience designing APIs and integrations, such as OAuth/OIDC, webhooks, synchronization or event-driven systems. The ability to move between high-level architecture and hands-on implementation and debugging. A pragmatic product mindset: you judge technical decisions by their effect on reliability, delivery speed and customer value. jobs.title: Go-to-Market Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir bauen die Software, mit der WEG- und Mietverwaltungen ihren Alltag rechtssicher und ohne Medienbrüche organisieren, umfangreich und modern, aber erschwinglich, für das digitale Zeitalter der Immobilienwirtschaft. Die Immobilienverwaltung zählt zu den analogsten Branchen in Deutschland, genau das wollen wir ändern. Unser Team kombiniert Erfahrung aus dem Verwalteralltag mit dem IT-Know-how eines innovativen Tech-Unternehmens. Seit unserer Gründung 2020 sind wir aus der Praxis für die Praxis gewachsen. Wir sind ein Team von 26 Menschen in Brühl bei Köln, das Verantwortung ernst nimmt und Entscheidungen schnell trifft. Wir wachsen und mit uns die Anforderungen an unsere Infrastruktur über Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success hinweg. Dafür suchen wir keine Person, die HubSpot verwaltet, sondern jemanden, der sie baut: Strukturen, Automatisierungen und Tracking, die den gesamten Weg vom ersten Kontakt bis zur langfristigen Kundenbeziehung sauber abbilden. Du berichtest direkt an unsere CRO. Aufgaben Du übernimmst HubSpot als zentrale Infrastruktur für Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success und baust Strukturen, die mit unserem Wachstum mitskalieren. Du entwickelst Automatisierungen, die manuelle Arbeit aus unseren Teams herausnehmen, von Content-Automatisierung über Lead-Routing bis zu automatisierten Abläufen im Customer Success, etwa beim Onboarding neuer Kund:innen. Du baust mit n8n oder vergleichbaren Low-Code-Tools Workflows, die Systeme miteinander verbinden, die bisher nebeneinander laufen. Du setzt KI gezielt dort ein, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringt: bei Recherche, Optimierung, Datenanreicherung oder Content-Erstellung. Bei Bedarf baust du auch mal eine Landingpage in Webflow oder ein Tracking-Setup, das uns zeigt, was auf dem Weg zum Kunden tatsächlich funktioniert. Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Vertrieb und Customer Success zusammen und verstehst deren Prozesse gut genug, um sie in Systeme zu übersetzen, die im Alltag wirklich helfen. Qualifikation Gute bis sehr gute HubSpot-Kenntnisse: Du hast bereits Strukturen aufgebaut, nicht nur gepflegt, und weißt, wie Workflows, Properties und Automatisierungen zusammenspielen. Fortgeschrittene Erfahrung mit Automatisierung über Low-Code- oder No-Code-Tools wie n8n. Echtes Interesse an KI und was sie im Business-Kontext leisten kann. Du musst kein Profi sein, aber du hast bereits ausprobiert, gelernt und weißt, wo KI wirklich hilft und wo nicht. Ein Systemblick: Du denkst in Prozessen über Teamgrenzen hinweg, nicht in einzelnen Tickets, hast das Gesamtsystem im Kopf und weißt, wie sich eine Änderung an einer Stelle an anderer Stelle auswirkt. Technikaffinität, die über HubSpot hinausgeht. Ein Tool wie Webflow schreckt dich nicht ab. Bock, in einem Startup mitzugestalten, statt in einem eingespielten Prozess zu verwalten. Wer zu uns passt Wir suchen niemanden, der schon alles kann. Wir suchen jemanden mit echtem Interesse an der Aufgabe. Jemanden, der Automatisierung und KI nicht nur kennt, sondern gerne selbst in die Hand nimmt. Wichtig ist, dass du KI oder Automatisierung bereits im Business-Kontext eingesetzt, nicht nur privat ausprobiert hast. Das kann jemand mit ersten Erfahrungen sein, der Lust hat, sich weiter reinzuarbeiten, oder jemand mit viel Erfahrung, der Bock auf die nächste Stufe hat. Senior oder Expertin musst du dafür nicht sein. Entscheidend ist, dass dir das Bauen selbst Spaß macht, nicht nur das Ergebnis. Was SCALARA bietet Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem CRO und echte Verantwortung ab dem ersten Tag. Die Möglichkeit, eine Infrastruktur von Grund auf mitzugestalten, statt eine bestehende zu verwalten. Ein Tech-Unternehmen, das auf Innovation und KI setzt und in dem gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden. Arbeitskultur: Ein offenes, wertschätzendes Team von 26 Menschen in Brühl bei Köln, das eng zusammenarbeitet und mit Herzblut und Spaß bei der Sache ist. Flexibilität: Hybrides Arbeiten zwischen Büro in Brühl und Home-Office, remote Arbeiten auf Anfrag

jobs.title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations
jobs.description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. The Opportunity Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone. The Role As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems: Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio. Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech. Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”. Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio. Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment

jobs.description: About the Role Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story. Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required. Technical Must Have’s: We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater ( https://chromium.github.io/octane/ ). A backup system for power and internet. A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day. Compensation: Base pay 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue. Uncapped earning potential Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance. We help learners at all stages of education build confidence, improve skills, and achieve their goals through personalised learning. Start sharing your programming knowledge and help students build real-world coding skills. Apply today and join FindTutors as an Online Programming Tutor with flexible, rewarding opportunities. jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Compliance Automation
jobs.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . The Product Foundations team within Coinbase 's Platform product group builds the systems that protect Coinbase , our customers, and the broader crypto ecosystem, powering identity verification, money movement, and regulatory compliance across every jurisdiction. As the Group Product Manager for Compliance Automation, you'll lead the product vision and multi-year strategy for the AI/ML-powered systems that automate Coinbase 's regulatory obligations, including sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity detection, and risk-based compliance workflows. Compliance operations represent one of Coinbase 's largest investments, and you'll own the strategy to strengthen and scale those capabilities through intelligent automation, reducing cost and regulatory risk while enabling the company to operate and grow globally. What you'll do: Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for Coinbase 's Compliance Automation platform, covering sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, suspicious activity detection, and risk-based compliance workflows. Lead a team of PMs to define, prioritize, and deliver AI/ML-powered capabilities that reduce manual compliance effort, increase detection accuracy, and scale compliance operations across jurisdictions. Drive significant cost optimization by identifying and executing automation opportunities across one of Coinbase 's largest operational cost centers, without increasing regulatory risk. Partner with Compliance, Legal, Trust & Risk, Engineering, and Data Science to ensure automation systems meet regulatory requirements while enabling product velocity. Shape the integration of emerging AI/ML technologies to strengthen compliance detection, reduce false positive rates, and accelerate case resolution. Build and maintain relationships with regulatory and compliance stakeholders, translating evolving regulatory requirements into actionable product capabilities. Required Skills and Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with significant experience in AI/ML-powered automation, compliance technology, or operational automation at scale. Experience leading large, complex cross-functional programs with multiple workstreams, including managing managers or leading PM teams. Demonstrated ability to partner with ML engineers on agentic AI architectures and translate technical capabilities into compliance product strategy. Proven track record with regulatory compliance frameworks (sanctions, transaction monitoring, AML/BSA) and navigating compliance approval processes. Experience driving executive-level alignment and communicating investment tradeoffs to senior leadership (VP+, ET) with clarity and precision. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $243,865—$286,900 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regar
